question: What is the difference between leisure and sport?
expected_answer: Leisure is free time spent away from business, work, domestic chores and education
answer:
Leisure refers to free time spent away from business, work, domestic chores, and education, excluding necessary activities like eating and sleeping (GSCS S4, p. 33). It involves things like entertaining friends, going on vacation, reading, watching TV, and dancing to music (GSCS S4, p. 33). 

Sport involves all forms of competitive physical activities, through casual or organized participation, that aim to use, maintain, or improve physical ability and skills while entertaining participants (GSCS S4, p. 39).
